title: The news industry is built to keep you anxious, but it does not have to be that way.
body:
Most news apps are designed like slot machines. They want to trigger a reaction, keep you scrolling, and maximize your time spent in the app. That model works for ad revenue, but it fails the reader. You end up feeling overwhelmed instead of informed.

At Headlinne, we built something different. We believe technology should work for you, not against you. Our goal is not to keep you glued to your screen for hours. Our goal is to give you a clear, accurate picture of what matters in the time you actually have.

We use AI to cut through the noise, not to create more of it. By focusing on personalization rather than outrage, we can surface the stories that align with your actual interests. It is about reclaiming your attention and making news a tool for understanding the world, not a source of daily stress.

We are building a calmer, smarter way to stay informed. It is a simple shift, but it changes everything.
cta: See how we are rethinking the news at HEADLINNE.com.
